description: Layered memory: recall at session start, capture and consolidate at session end

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 && $p -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))' 2>/dev/null && exec $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/memory.py" hook session-start; done; exit 0

for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 && $p -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))' 2>/dev/null && exec $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/memory.py" hook session-end; done; exit 0
